name: Fine Organic Industries Ltd
title: Fine Organic Industries Ltd - 541557 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Specialty additives maker at full utilisation with FY27 guided flat on volumes until SEZ commissioning in 2H FY28; sustainable EBITDA 18-20% reiterated, while capex and acquisitions expand.

utilisation.quote: all our manufacturing facilities continue to run at almost full capacity levels, full utilisation levels

capex.quote: the investment is approximately INR 700 crores to INR 750 crores

triggers.label: Plants at full utilisation
triggers.quote: all our manufacturing facilities continue to run at almost full capacity levels, full utilisation levels

triggers.label: Volume flat until SEZ commissioning
triggers.quote: even next year is going to be a flat year, not only this year, but the next year is going to be flat

triggers.label: Raw material inflation to persist into FY27
triggers.quote: in '27, we should not expect lower price of raw materials, especially vegetable oils

triggers.label: SEZ capex INR 700-750 cr; US plant undisclosed
triggers.quote: the investment is approximately INR 700 crores to INR 750 crores

guidance.quote: And EBITDA, we will try to be between 18% to 20%
It's going to be very flat till the SEZ plant is commissioned
we believe that we will be able to start at least in the second half of 2028

guidance.value: 18 to 24 months from construction start, target 18
guidance.quote: the plant should be commissioned within 18 to 24 months. We will try for 18 months, most likely

red_flags.label: Flat volumes guided to FY28
red_flags.quote: even next year is going to be a flat year, not only this year, but the next year is going to be flat

red_flags.label: Short-term contracts only amid cost inflation
red_flags.quote: we have told the customers that we will not be able to make long-term contracts

red_flags.label: Acquisition and multi-country capex with thin disclosure
red_flags.quote: we are still to announce probably within next quarter, we will be able to give you the right figure

evasions.quote: No idea. My friend. No idea. As of now, no idea.
I will not give any production capacity figures.
we have requested Thailand people to bear with us for a few months
